universalSyntax.notation: CloudFormation NativeProperty, ValueExpression, parameters, mappings, conditions, outputs, JSON, and ASL documents render as side-panel rows/editors.
universalSyntax.interaction: Structured values are edited in the inspector instead of becoming graph nodes by default.

kernelSyntax.notation: Hidden metadata layer with lifecycle, generated, rationale, review, and trace badges.
Key-value chips attached to a card or listed in an annotations tab.
Separate traceability overlay with dashed labeled links and confidence filtering.
Expandable expression or document editor with compact card badge.
Readiness board and severity markers on affected elements.

complexityManagement.behavior: AwsStage lanes and SamStack containers are the primary scale controls; overview dashboards show counts and blockers.
Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, S3, IAM, Cognito, Step Functions, CloudWatch, and VPC resources expose containment-specific tabs.
NativeProperty, ValueExpression, parameters, mappings, conditions, outputs, policy JSON, OpenAPI, and ASL render in structured side panels.
Common AWS integrations use clean relationship edges while preserving underlying deployable resources in the inspector.
IAM statements, wildcard warnings, KMS usage, secrets, and policy target resources default to matrix/table presentation.
Far zoom shows stages/stacks and resource counts; mid zoom shows resource cards and ports; near zoom shows compartments and edge labels.
ProductionMode and AwsSecurityBaseline drive markers for public access, encryption, deletion protection, wildcard IAM, tracing/logging, and least privilege.
Trace links remain a separate layer with confidence filters.
Views persist filters, layout, camera positions, and edge-layer choices.
